```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import io
import requests
import urllib3
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```
Each row represents one name and year. The state columns
contain counts, and `Total` is the national count.

```{python}
urllib3.disable_warnings()

url = "https://posit.byui.edu/content/0d43d66f-d3b7-4c43-8c36-52e3ed69e7f1/names_year_csv.csv"

response = requests.get(url, verify=False)
response.raise_for_status()

df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(response.content))
df
```

# Filtering for David
'filter' keeps rows that satisfy a condition. Text comparisons use '==' and multiple conditions can be joined with '&'.
```{python}
david = df.filter(
    (pl.col("name") == "David") &
    (pl.col("year") >= 1980)
)

david.head()
```

# Adding a new column by summing selected columns
use 'sum_horizontal' when the addition happens across columns in the same row.

```{python}
sumDavid = david.with_columns(
    pl.sum_horizontal(
        (pl.col(["ID", "UT"])).fill_null(0)
    )
    .alias("ID_UT_David_Total")
)
sumDavid.head()
sumDavid.select(["ID", "UT", "ID_UT_David_Total"])
# Looking at only three columns of interest ^
```

# Making a proportion

```{python}
propDavid = sumDavid.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("Total") > 0)
        # The following code handles any 0 values that would cause issues by dividing by 0
        # Only the code within the then statement and alias are technically necessary
        .then(pl.col("ID_UT_David_Total")/pl.col("Total"))
        .otherwise(None)
        .alias("ID_UT_prop")
)

propDavid.head()
```

# Creating a plot with the proportion over time data

```{python}
q2 = (
    ggplot(
        data = propDavid, 
        mapping = aes(x = "year", y = "ID_UT_prop"))
        +geom_line(color = "#121ecf")
        +scale_x_continuous(format = 'd') 
        +scale_y_continuous(format = ".2%")
)
q2
```

# A little data validation
Is the total actually the total?

```{python}
state_cols = [
    "AK", "AL", "AR", "AZ", "CA", "CO", "CT", "DC", "DE", "FL", "GA",
    "HI", "IA", "ID", "IL", "IN", "KS", "KY", "LA", "MA", "MD", "ME",
    "MI", "MN", "MO", "MS", "MT", "NC", "ND", "NE", "NH", "NJ", "NM",
    "NV", "NY", "OH", "OK", "OR", "PA", "RI", "SC", "SD", "TN", "TX",
    "UT", "VA", "VT", "WA", "WI", "WV", "WY"
]
```
```{python}
q3 = (
    df
    .filter(pl.col("name") == "Olivia")
    .with_columns(
        pl.sum_horizontal(pl.col(state_cols))
          .alias("Calculated_Total")
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("Calculated_Total") != pl.col("Total"))
           .alias("Does_Not_Match")
    )
    .select(["year", "Calculated_Total", "Total", "Does_Not_Match"])
    .sort("year")
)
q3
```

Display only the years that do not agree

```{python}
q3.filter(pl.col("Does_Not_Match"))
```
